title: Not All Test-Time Compute Is Evidence: Model-Specific Bias in LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 并非所有测试时计算都是证据：大语言模型推理中的模型特定偏差

paragraphs.en: Test-time scaling methods implicitly assume that additional computation from the same model provides independent evidence. We show that this assumption fails within a single reasoning model: errors are correlated across repeated samples, across reasoning depth, and in the model’s own self-evaluation, so more compute from the same model is not more evidence. We introduce Dia ( D isagreement-triggered I ndependent A rbitration), which treats disagreement between an intermediate-stage and the final-stage prediction as a per-question signal of reasoning instability and resolves it by asking a small panel of heterogeneous models to solve the question independently, without seeing either candidate, and aggregating their answers directly. Across seven benchmarks and two base models, Dia outperforms full chain-of-thought in 12 of 14 settings, including a 7.00% gain on MuSiQue, while activating on only ∼ {\sim} 17% of examples and using up to 47.2% fewer tokens than a multi-agent baseline. Ablations show that both independent solving and solver heterogeneity are necessary for these gains.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时扩展方法隐含地假设来自同一模型的额外计算能够提供独立的证据。 我们证明这一假设在单一推理模型内部并不成立：错误在重复采样之间、在推理深度上以及模型自身的自评估中都存在相关性，因此来自同一模型的更多计算并不等于更多证据。 我们提出 Dia（分歧触发的独立仲裁，Disagreement-triggered Independent Arbitration），它将中间阶段与最终阶段预测之间的分歧视为每个问题的推理不稳定性信号，并通过让一小组异构模型在不查看任何候选答案的情况下独立求解该问题，再直接聚合它们的答案来解决该分歧。 在七个基准和两个基座模型上，Dia 在 14 个设置中的 12 个上超越了完整思维链，包括在 MuSiQue 上取得 7.00% 的提升，同时仅在约 {\sim} 17% 的样本上激活，且比多智能体基线最多少用 47.2% 的 token。 消融实验表明，独立求解与求解器异构性对于这些提升都是必不可少的。

paragraphs.en: Test-time scaling has become a central strategy for improving reasoning in large language models: chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , repeated sampling with majority vote ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , adaptive early exit ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) , and multi-agent reasoning ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) all convert additional inference-time computation into accuracy gains ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . Test-time scaling is particularly effective when additional computation contributes evidence that is sufficiently complementary to the model’s current belief, allowing errors to be corrected rather than repeatedly reinforced. However, computation from the same model can remain shaped by persistent model-specific error bias , limiting the diversity of the evidence it provides. We observe three manifestations of this phenomenon across generation, reasoning, and self-evaluation (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 测试时扩展已成为提升大型语言模型推理能力的核心策略：思维链提示（Wei et al., 2022）、结合多数投票的重复采样（Wang et al., 2023）、自适应提前退出（Yang et al., 2026; Fu et al., 2025; Dai et al., 2025）以及多智能体推理（Wu et al., 2024; Li et al., 2023; Li et al., 2024）都能将额外的推理时计算转化为准确率的提升（Snell et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025）。 当额外计算能够提供与模型当前信念足够互补的证据时，测试时扩展尤为有效，这使得错误可以被纠正，而不是被反复强化。 然而，来自同一模型的计算可能仍受其固有的模型特定错误偏差的影响，从而限制了其所提供证据的多样性。 我们在生成、推理和自我评估三个环节中观察到该现象的三种表现（图1）。

paragraphs.en: (a) Generation bias under repeated sampling. Repeated sampling can diversify reasoning traces without necessarily diversifying their failures. When self-consistency produces an incorrect majority answer, erroneous samples frequently concentrate on the same dominant wrong answer rather than spreading across alternatives, indicating a persistent generation bias rather than independent error modes (Section 2.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: (a) 重复采样下的生成偏差。 重复采样可以使推理轨迹多样化，但并不一定使其错误多样化。 当自一致性产生错误的多数答案时，错误样本往往集中在同一个主导性错误答案上，而不是分散在不同的备选答案中，这表明存在持续的生成偏差，而非相互独立的错误模式（第 2.1 节）。

sents.en: (a) Generation bias under repeated sampling.
sents.zh: (a) 重复采样下的生成偏差。

sents.en: Repeated sampling can diversify reasoning traces without necessarily diversifying their failures.
sents.zh: 重复采样可以使推理轨迹多样化，但并不一定使其错误多样化。

sents.en: When self-consistency produces an incorrect majority answer, erroneous samples frequently concentrate on the same dominant wrong answer rather than spreading across alternatives, indicating a persistent generation bias rather than independent error modes (Section 2.1 ).
sents.zh: 当自一致性产生错误的多数答案时，错误样本往往集中在同一个主导性错误答案上，而不是分散在不同的备选答案中，这表明存在持续的生成偏差，而非相互独立的错误模式（第 2.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: (b) Initial-answer persistence bias. Reasoning does not necessarily provide evidence independent of a model’s initial judgment. When a model is first asked to answer directly and then asked to reason before answering, its post-reasoning prediction can remain strongly associated with the initial answer; in particular, an initially incorrect prediction may persist through subsequent reasoning rather than being corrected (Section 2.2 ). Prior work similarly suggests that reasoning models can form strong preliminary answer preferences ( Dang et al., 2026 ) , that extended reasoning can lead to overthinking ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and that early errors may propagate through subsequent reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: (b) 初始答案持续性偏差。 推理不一定能提供独立于模型初始判断的证据。 当模型首先被要求直接作答、然后被要求在回答前进行推理时，其推理后的预测可能与初始答案保持强关联；特别是，初始错误的预测可能在后续推理中持续存在，而不是被纠正（第 2.2 节）。 先前的工作同样表明，推理模型可能形成强烈的初步答案偏好（Dang et al., 2026）、扩展推理可能导致过度思考（Zhou et al., 2026），以及早期错误可能在后续推理中传播（Zhang et al., 2024）。

sents.zh: (b) 初始答案持续性偏差。

sents.en: Prior work similarly suggests that reasoning models can form strong preliminary answer preferences ( Dang et al., 2026 ) , that extended reasoning can lead to overthinking ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and that early errors may propagate through subsequent reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 先前的工作同样表明，推理模型可能形成强烈的初步答案偏好（Dang et al., 2026）、扩展推理可能导致过度思考（Zhou et al., 2026），以及早期错误可能在后续推理中传播（Zhang et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: (c) Longer-reasoning preference bias. A related bias appears when the model is asked to evaluate competing answers produced at different stages of its own reasoning. Rather than judging the candidates symmetrically, the model strongly favors the later, more elaborate reasoning outcome, even when the earlier answer is correct. In our experiments, the model selects the later-stage answer in over 95% of disagreements and remains highly confident even when this preference leads to an incorrect decision (Section 2.3 ). This behavior is related to previously documented length and verbosity biases in LLM-based evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: (c) 更长推理偏好偏差。 一个相关的偏差出现在要求模型评估其自身推理的不同阶段所产生的相互竞争的答案时。 模型并非对称地评判候选答案，而是强烈偏爱较晚出现的、更详尽的推理结果，即使较早的答案是正确的。 在我们的实验中，当两个答案不一致时，模型在超过 95% 的情况下选择较后阶段的答案，并且即使这种偏好导致错误的决策，模型仍然保持高度自信（第 2.3 节）。 这种行为与之前文献中记录的基于 LLM 的评估中的长度偏差和冗长偏差有关（Zheng et al., 2023; Hu et al., 2025）。

sents.en: (c) Longer-reasoning preference bias.
sents.zh: (c) 更长推理偏好偏差。

paragraphs.en: Together, these observations suggest that:
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些观察结果表明：

paragraphs.en: model-specific error bias persists across generation , reasoning , and self-evaluation , that is, the three stages of same-model computation that test-time scaling methods rely on. More compute from the same model is therefore not more evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 特定于模型的错误偏差在生成、推理和自我评估这三个阶段中持续存在，而这三个阶段正是测试时扩展方法所依赖的同模型计算的三个环节。 因此，来自同一个模型的更多计算并不等于更多证据。

sents.en: model-specific error bias persists across generation , reasoning , and self-evaluation , that is, the three stages of same-model computation that test-time scaling methods rely on.
sents.zh: 特定于模型的错误偏差在生成、推理和自我评估这三个阶段中持续存在，而这三个阶段正是测试时扩展方法所依赖的同模型计算的三个环节。

sents.en: More compute from the same model is therefore not more evidence.
sents.zh: 因此，来自同一个模型的更多计算并不等于更多证据。

paragraphs.en: These findings suggest that useful additional computation should provide evidence that is both selectively acquired and complementary to the base model’s existing reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现表明，有用的额外计算应当提供既有选择性地获取、又与基础模型已有推理互补的证据。

paragraphs.en: (1) When to seek additional evidence. Prior work shows that intermediate predictions and answer-stability signals can reveal how reasoning evolves and support adaptive computation ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) , while extended reasoning is not always beneficial ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Motivated by these observations, we use disagreement between an intermediate prediction and the final prediction as a simple per-question signal of reasoning instability.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 何时寻求额外证据。 先前的工作表明，中间预测和答案稳定性信号可以揭示推理如何演化并支持自适应计算 ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) ，而延长推理并不总是有益的 ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) 。 受这些观察启发，我们使用中间预测与最终预测之间的不一致作为一种简单的、针对每个问题的推理不稳定性信号。

sents.en: (1) When to seek additional evidence.
sents.zh: (1) 何时寻求额外证据。

sents.en: Prior work shows that intermediate predictions and answer-stability signals can reveal how reasoning evolves and support adaptive computation ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) , while extended reasoning is not always beneficial ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .

sents.zh: 受这些观察启发，我们使用中间预测与最终预测之间的不一致作为一种简单的、针对每个问题的推理不稳定性信号。

paragraphs.en: (2) Where the evidence should come from. For such cases, we seek complementary evidence from heterogeneous LLMs. Prior ensemble studies show that different models exhibit complementary strengths and can succeed on different subsets of problems ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , suggesting that model heterogeneity can reduce dependence on the particular error tendencies of the base model.
paragraphs.zh: （2）证据应来自何处。 针对这类情况，我们从异构大语言模型中寻求补充证据。 已有的集成研究表明，不同模型各具互补优势，并能在不同的问题子集上取得成功（Jiang 等，2023；Wang 等，2025），这表明模型异构性可以降低对基座模型特定错误倾向的依赖。

sents.en: (2) Where the evidence should come from.
sents.zh: （2）证据应来自何处。

sents.en: For such cases, we seek complementary evidence from heterogeneous LLMs.
sents.zh: 针对这类情况，我们从异构大语言模型中寻求补充证据。

sents.en: Prior ensemble studies show that different models exhibit complementary strengths and can succeed on different subsets of problems ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , suggesting that model heterogeneity can reduce dependence on the particular error tendencies of the base model.
sents.zh: 已有的集成研究表明，不同模型各具互补优势，并能在不同的问题子集上取得成功（Jiang 等，2023；Wang 等，2025），这表明模型异构性可以降低对基座模型特定错误倾向的依赖。

paragraphs.en: (3) How the evidence should be combined. We let these solvers reason independently, without seeing the base model’s candidate predictions, and aggregate their answers directly, consistent with evidence that voting-based ensembles can be competitive with more elaborate multi-agent protocols ( Li et al., 2024 ; Smit et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: (3) 应如何整合这些证据。 我们让这些求解器独立推理，不查看基础模型的候选预测，并直接聚合它们的答案，这与投票式集成可以与更复杂的多智能体协议相媲美的证据一致（Li et al., 2024；Smit et al., 2024）。

sents.en: (3) How the evidence should be combined.
sents.zh: (3) 应如何整合这些证据。

sents.en: We let these solvers reason independently, without seeing the base model’s candidate predictions, and aggregate their answers directly, consistent with evidence that voting-based ensembles can be competitive with more elaborate multi-agent protocols ( Li et al., 2024 ; Smit et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 我们让这些求解器独立推理，不查看基础模型的候选预测，并直接聚合它们的答案，这与投票式集成可以与更复杂的多智能体协议相媲美的证据一致（Li et al., 2024；Smit et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: These three principles lead to Dia ( D isagreement-triggered I ndependent A rbitration): agreement between the intermediate and final predictions is returned directly, whereas such reasoning-stage disagreement activates a small heterogeneous solver panel for candidate-blind, answer-level arbitration.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个原则引出了 Dia（Disagreement-triggered Independent Arbitration，由分歧触发的独立仲裁）：当中间预测与最终预测一致时，直接返回该结果；而当推理阶段出现分歧时，则激活一个小型异构智能体面板，进行候选盲选、答案级别的仲裁。

paragraphs.en: Across seven benchmarks and two base models (Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B; Yang et al., 2025 ), Dia outperforms full chain-of-thought in 12 of 14 settings, including an improvement from 59.0% to 66.0% on MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) , while activating on only ∼ {\sim} 17% of examples and using up to 47.2% fewer tokens than a fully-connected multi-agent baseline that invokes every agent on all questions. A multi-agent baseline that routes independent agent outputs through a centralized judge underperforms direct answer aggregation, e.g., 60.67% vs. 66.00% on MuSiQue with Qwen3-4B, highlighting the importance of the aggregation protocol.

paragraphs.en: Reasoning is expected to provide additional evidence beyond a model’s initial judgment. However, a model may already exhibit a strong answer preference before any explicit reasoning, and the same preference can remain after full reasoning. To examine this initial-answer persistence, we first ask the model to produce a direct answer without reasoning and ask the same model to solve the same question with full chain-of-thought reasoning. We measure whether the final answer retains the initial answer, particularly when the initial answer is incorrect.

paragraphs.en: A model’s prediction can change as reasoning proceeds. To capture this change, we compare an intermediate-stage prediction , obtained at an intermediate reasoning stage where the model is sufficiently confident, with the final-stage prediction produced after the model completes its reasoning. When the two disagree, which we call a reasoning-stage disagreement , one simple way to resolve the conflict is to let the model select between its own two predictions. This choice may not be neutral: the model may systematically favor the final-stage prediction simply because it follows more reasoning. We examine this bias with Qwen3-8B on reasoning-stage disagreements. Candidates are anonymized and their presentation order is balanced.
paragraphs.zh: 模型的预测可能会随着推理的进行而改变。 为了捕捉这种变化，我们将中间阶段预测——即在模型已有足够置信度的中间推理阶段所得到的预测——与模型完成推理后产生的最终阶段预测进行比较。 当两者不一致时，我们称之为推理阶段分歧，解决这种冲突的一种简单方法是让模型在自己的两个预测之间做出选择。 这种选择可能并非中性：模型可能会仅仅因为最终阶段预测经历了更多推理而系统性地偏向它。 我们使用 Qwen3-8B 在推理阶段分歧上考察了这种偏差。 候选项经过匿名化处理，其呈现顺序也进行了平衡。

paragraphs.en: We compare Dia with seven baselines, grouped by the kind of intervention each applies against model-specific error bias. ① Standard reasoning. CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) lets the base model complete its reasoning and returns the final prediction. ② Adaptive reasoning. DEER ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and Dynasor ( Fu et al., 2025 ) use intermediate reasoning signals to decide whether continued reasoning is necessary: DEER relies on confidence at intermediate reasoning states, whereas Dynasor, in its CoT setting, uses the stability of intermediate predictions. Like Dia , both act on signals exposed before reasoning terminates, but they modify the computation of the same model rather than seeking evidence outside it. ③ Multi-agent inference. We consider two protocols using the same four-agent pool. MAS-Exchange ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) uses fully-connected communication: agents first solve the question independently, observe all peer responses, revise once, and then vote. MAS-Judge ( Wang et al., 2025 ) removes peer-to-peer communication: agents solve independently, after which a centralized judge, instantiated by the base model, observes all responses and selects the final answer. ④ Learning-based debiasing. We test whether model-specific error bias can be reduced through parameter updates: SFT trains the base model on its own correct samples and DPO then prefers correct over incorrect samples of the same question (details in Appendix A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Dia 与七种基线进行比较，并按每种方法针对模型特定错误偏差所施加干预的类型进行分组。① 标准推理。 CoT（Wei et al., 2022）让基础模型完成其推理并返回最终预测。② 自适应推理。 DEER（Yang et al., 2026）和 Dynasor（Fu et al., 2025）利用中间推理信号来判断是否需要继续推理：DEER 依赖于中间推理状态下的置信度，而 Dynasor 在其 CoT 设置中使用中间预测的稳定性。 与 Dia 一样，两者都作用于推理结束前暴露出的信号，但它们修改的是同一模型的计算，而不是在该模型之外寻找证据。③ 多智能体推理。 我们考虑使用同一个四智能体池的两种协议。 MAS-Exchange（Wu et al., 2024；Li et al., 2023）采用全连接通信：智能体首先独立解题，观察所有同伴的回答，修订一次，然后投票。 MAS-Judge（Wang et al., 2025）去除了智能体之间的点对点通信：智能体独立解题，之后由基础模型实例化的集中式裁判观察所有回答并选出最终答案。④ 基于学习的去偏。 我们测试能否通过参数更新来减少模型特定的错误偏差：SFT 在基础模型自身的正确样本上进行训练，随后 DPO 对同一问题的正确样本给予高于错误样本的偏好（细节见附录 A.2）。

paragraphs.en: Observation ①. Dia achieves the highest average accuracy at both model scales. paragraphs.en: Observation ②. Detecting unstable reasoning is not sufficient; the source of corrective evidence matters. DEER and Dynasor modify or terminate the base model’s reasoning using intermediate signals, whereas Dia uses such signals to request independent evidence from heterogeneous models. Dia achieves higher accuracy than both adaptive-reasoning baselines in all 14 settings, although at a higher token cost than early exit.
paragraphs.zh: 观察②。 检测到不稳定推理并不足够，纠正性证据的来源同样重要。 DEER 和 Dynasor 使用中间信号来修改或终止基础模型的推理，而 Dia 则使用此类信号向异构模型请求独立证据。 Dia 在全部 14 种设置中的准确率均高于两个自适应推理基线，尽管其 token 开销高于提前退出。

sents.en: Observation ②.

paragraphs.en: Observation ③. How multiple models are combined matters as much as having multiple models. MAS-Exchange introduces cross-agent conditioning before the final vote, while MAS-Judge preserves independent generation but introduces a candidate-aware centralized decision. Dia avoids both operations and directly aggregates independently obtained answers. Compared with MAS-Exchange, it improves average accuracy by 1.26% and 0.96% with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B while lowering the average token ratio by about 30% at both scales, and it also exceeds MAS-Judge in average accuracy with fewer tokens; Section 4.3 examines the underlying mechanism.

paragraphs.en: We test whether external models can resolve reasoning-stage disagreements by comparing the candidate reasoning traces rather than solving the question independently. We use Qwen3-8B as the base model and retain the three default external models as reviewers on MuSR and MMLU-Pro. Candidates are anonymized and their presentation order is balanced. Each reviewer independently selects one candidate, and the final decision follows a two-of-three majority vote.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试外部模型能否通过比较候选推理轨迹而非独立解题，来解决推理阶段的分歧。 我们使用 Qwen3-8B 作为基础模型，并在 MuSR 和 MMLU-Pro 上保留三个默认的外部模型作为评审。 候选答案经过匿名化处理，其呈现顺序是均衡的。 每位评审独立选择一个候选答案，最终决定遵循三票中取二的多数投票。

paragraphs.en: With complete traces, the ensemble selects the final-stage prediction in over 90% of disagreements on both datasets (Table 3 ), and rarely recovers a correct intermediate-stage prediction. The final-stage preference therefore persists even with heterogeneous reviewers.

paragraphs.en: To examine the role of presentation, Qwen3-8B summarizes each trace with the same prompt, structure, and approximately matched token budget. This reduces the final-stage preference and the directional asymmetry, but selection accuracy improves only slightly on MuSR and decreases on MMLU-Pro. Takeaway. These results motivate asking external solvers to answer the question independently rather than judge competing traces.
paragraphs.zh: 为考察呈现方式的作用，Qwen3-8B 使用相同的提示词、结构和大致匹配的 token 预算来总结每条轨迹。 这降低了最终阶段的偏好性和方向性不对称，但选择准确率在 MuSR 上仅略有提升，在 MMLU-Pro 上则有所下降。结论。 这些结果促使我们让外部求解器独立回答问题，而不是对相互竞争的轨迹进行评判。

paragraphs.en: Arbitration accuracy decreases on all three datasets, with drops of more than 30% on both 2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue (Table 4 ). On these two datasets, every question answered correctly by the homogeneous panel is also answered correctly by the heterogeneous panel. This pattern is consistent with the model-specific error bias discussed in Section 2 . Takeaway. It supports using heterogeneous solvers to obtain corrective evidence rather than relying on repeated samples from the base model.

paragraphs.en: The errors of a language model are not independent across samples, reasoning steps, or self-evaluation. At the generation level, models commit to an answer early and then rationalize it ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , larger models misfire at the commitment step despite retaining the correct answer ( Yeom et al., 2026 ) , and this commitment is skewed by surface features and prior beliefs ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Dasgupta et al., 2022 ) . Because such biases are shared across samples, majority voting over repeated samples ( Wang et al., 2023 ) can amplify a shared wrong answer rather than average it out. At the reasoning level, chain-of-thought explanations can be unfaithful to the factors that drive the prediction ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) , reasoning models form strong preliminary answer preferences that trigger overthinking ( Dang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , and longer reasoning does not reliably improve accuracy ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . At the evaluation level, LLM judges exhibit position, verbosity, and self-preference biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wataoka et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . Prior work studies these biases in isolation, largely on multiple-choice or short chain-of-thought settings; we show that they co-occur within a single reasoning model and address them at test time by acquiring evidence from outside the model.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型的错误在样本之间、推理步骤之间以及自我评估之间并非相互独立。 在生成层面，模型会过早地确定答案并随后进行合理化（Zhang et al., 2024）；更大的模型尽管仍保留了正确答案，却会在确定答案这一步出错（Yeom et al., 2026）；而这种确定性会被表面特征和先验信念所偏移（Zheng et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2024；Dasgupta et al., 2022）。 由于这类偏差在各样本之间是共享的，对重复样本进行多数投票（Wang et al., 2023）可能会放大同一个共享的错误答案，而不是将其平均消除。 在推理层面，思维链的解释可能并不忠实于驱动预测的因素（Turpin et al., 2023）；推理模型会形成强烈的初步答案偏好，从而触发过度思考（Dang et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2025）；而且更长的推理并不能可靠地提高准确率（Zhou et al., 2026）。 在评估层面，LLM 评判者表现出位置、冗长和自我偏好偏差（Zheng et al., 2023；Wataoka et al., 2024；Ye et al., 2025；Hu et al., 2025）。 已有工作大多在选择题或短思维链设置下孤立地研究这些偏差；我们则表明这些偏差会在同一个推理模型内共同出现，并通过在测试时从模型之外获取证据来解决它们。

sents.en: The errors of a language model are not independent across samples, reasoning steps, or self-evaluation.
sents.zh: 语言模型的错误在样本之间、推理步骤之间以及自我评估之间并非相互独立。

sents.en: At the generation level, models commit to an answer early and then rationalize it ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , larger models misfire at the commitment step despite retaining the correct answer ( Yeom et al., 2026 ) , and this commitment is skewed by surface features and prior beliefs ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Dasgupta et al., 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 在生成层面，模型会过早地确定答案并随后进行合理化（Zhang et al., 2024）；更大的模型尽管仍保留了正确答案，却会在确定答案这一步出错（Yeom et al., 2026）；而这种确定性会被表面特征和先验信念所偏移（Zheng et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2024；Dasgupta et al., 2022）。

sents.en: Because such biases are shared across samples, majority voting over repeated samples ( Wang et al., 2023 ) can amplify a shared wrong answer rather than average it out.
sents.zh: 由于这类偏差在各样本之间是共享的，对重复样本进行多数投票（Wang et al., 2023）可能会放大同一个共享的错误答案，而不是将其平均消除。

sents.en: At the reasoning level, chain-of-thought explanations can be unfaithful to the factors that drive the prediction ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) , reasoning models form strong preliminary answer preferences that trigger overthinking ( Dang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , and longer reasoning does not reliably improve accuracy ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 在推理层面，思维链的解释可能并不忠实于驱动预测的因素（Turpin et al., 2023）；推理模型会形成强烈的初步答案偏好，从而触发过度思考（Dang et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2025）；而且更长的推理并不能可靠地提高准确率（Zhou et al., 2026）。

sents.en: At the evaluation level, LLM judges exhibit position, verbosity, and self-preference biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Wataoka et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 在评估层面，LLM 评判者表现出位置、冗长和自我偏好偏差（Zheng et al., 2023；Wataoka et al., 2024；Ye et al., 2025；Hu et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Prior work studies these biases in isolation, largely on multiple-choice or short chain-of-thought settings; we show that they co-occur within a single reasoning model and address them at test time by acquiring evidence from outside the model.
sents.zh: 已有工作大多在选择题或短思维链设置下孤立地研究这些偏差；我们则表明这些偏差会在同一个推理模型内共同出现，并通过在测试时从模型之外获取证据来解决它们。

paragraphs.en: Test-time compute can be allocated adaptively ( Snell et al., 2025 ) , either by constraining reasoning length ( Han et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025 ) or by monitoring intermediate answers and stopping once they stabilize or become confident ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) . These methods decide how much to compute and trust the intermediate-stage prediction whenever it is confident, which is where the preliminary-answer bias above resides. Dia uses the same kind of signal to decide when to seek external evidence, and retains both the intermediate-stage and final-stage predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时计算可以被自适应地分配（Snell et al., 2025），方式包括约束推理长度（Han et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025；Aggarwal and Welleck, 2025），或者监控中间答案并在其稳定或变得可信后停止（Fu et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2026；Dai et al., 2025）。 这些方法决定计算多少，并在中间阶段预测可信时予以信任，而这正是上述初步答案偏差所在之处。 Dia 使用同类信号来决定何时寻求外部证据，并同时保留中间阶段与最终阶段的预测。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent methods improve reasoning by letting agents exchange and revise answers ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) , by layering models on earlier outputs ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , or by sampling more agents and voting ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Recent analyses question whether communication adds independent evidence: agents conform to a majority, especially when uncertain, and frequently switch from a correct answer to an incorrect one to match their peers ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Cho et al., 2025 ; Wynn et al., 2025 ) ; most of the benefit of debate comes from majority voting rather than from the exchange itself ( Smit et al., 2024 ; Choi et al., 2025 ) ; and many failures of agent systems trace to inter-agent misalignment and weak verification ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) . Cost is a further concern, since invoking a full agent system on every query is expensive, which motivates query-dependent agent architectures ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Dia is designed around these findings: solvers reason independently and never see the base model’s candidates or each other, their answers are aggregated directly rather than through a candidate-aware judge, which inherits the judge biases above (Table 3 ), the panel is heterogeneous because homogeneous solvers share the base model’s error modes (Section 4.3.2 ), and it is invoked only on reasoning-stage disagreements.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体方法通过让智能体交换并修改答案（Wu et al., 2024；Li et al., 2023；Liang et al., 2024）、在先前输出之上叠加模型（Wang et al., 2025），或采样更多智能体并进行投票（Li et al., 2024）来改进推理。 近期的分析对通信是否带来独立证据提出质疑：智能体会从众于多数意见，尤其是在不确定时，并且经常从正确答案切换到错误答案以与同伴保持一致（Zhu et al., 2025；Cho et al., 2025；Wynn et al., 2025）；辩论的大部分收益来自多数投票而非交流本身（Smit et al., 2024；Choi et al., 2025）；许多智能体系统的失败可追溯至智能体之间的失调与薄弱的验证（Cemri et al., 2025）。 成本是另一个关注点，因为对每个查询都调用完整的智能体系统代价高昂，这促使了依赖查询的智能体架构的出现（Liu et al., 2023；Zhang et al., 2025）。 Dia 正是围绕这些发现设计的：求解器独立推理，从不看到基础模型的候选答案或彼此的答案；它们的答案被直接聚合，而不是通过感知候选答案的裁判来聚合，后者会继承上述裁判偏差（表 3）；求解器面板是异构的，因为同构的求解器会共享基础模型的错误模式（第 4.3.2 节）；并且该系统仅在推理阶段出现分歧时才被调用。

paragraphs.en: We show that model-specific error bias persists across repeated sampling, continued reasoning, and self-evaluation, so that more compute from the same model does not amount to more evidence. Dia uses reasoning-stage disagreement to trigger candidate-blind solving by heterogeneous models and aggregates their answers directly. Across seven benchmarks, it outperforms CoT in 12 of 14 settings and achieves higher average accuracy with fewer tokens than the multi-agent baselines. Ablations show that asking heterogeneous models to compare the base model’s reasoning traces inherits its final-stage preference, and that replacing the heterogeneous panel with repeated samples of the base model sharply reduces arbitration accuracy, so independent solving and solver heterogeneity are both necessary. The gains persist as the base model scales to 80B while the external solvers remain fixed. Test-time scaling should therefore consider where additional evidence comes from and how it is combined, not only how much computation is used.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了模型自身的错误偏倚在重复采样、持续推理和自我评估中持续存在，因此来自同一模型的更多计算量并不等同于更多证据。 Dia 利用推理阶段的分歧来触发由异构模型进行的、不接触候选答案的独立求解，并直接聚合它们的答案。 在七个基准测试中，它在 14 个设置中的 12 个上优于思维链，且与多智能体基线相比，以更少的 token 取得了更高的平均准确率。 消融实验表明，让异构模型比较基线模型的推理过程会继承其后期偏好，而将异构求解器替换为基线模型的重复采样会大幅降低仲裁准确率，因此独立求解与求解器异构性两者缺一不可。 当基线模型扩展到 80B 而外部求解器保持不变时，这些增益依然存在。 因此，测试时扩展应当考虑额外证据来自何处以及如何组合这些证据，而不仅仅是使用了多少计算量。

paragraphs.en: MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) contains 12,032 test questions from 14 broad knowledge domains. We sample 25 questions from each domain, yielding a balanced 350-question subset. For GPQA ( Rein et al., 2024 ) , we use the full Diamond split of 198 questions. The split contains 19 Biology, 93 Chemistry, and 86 Physics questions.

paragraphs.en: For DetectBench ( Gu et al., 2024 ) , we use 279 questions sampled without replacement from the 3,928 questions across the official train, dev, test, test-hard, and test-distract files. paragraphs.en: MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) covers seven subjects: Algebra, Counting and Probability, Geometry, Intermediate Algebra, Number Theory, Prealgebra, and Precalculus. We independently sample 100 questions from each of difficulty Levels 3, 4, and 5 from the official test split. This produces three equally sized subsets, or 300 questions in total, and balances the evaluation across difficulty levels.

paragraphs.en: For each dataset we construct a separate training set, sample the base model eight times per question, and label each sample as correct or incorrect. SFT trains the base model for two epochs on the correct samples; DPO then trains for one epoch on preference pairs in which a correct sample is preferred over an incorrect sample of the same question. These baselines test whether repeatedly observed error modes can be learned away, as opposed to bypassed at inference time using complementary external evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个数据集，我们构建一个单独的训练集，对每个问题将基模型采样八次，并将每个样本标注为正确或不正确。 SFT 在正确样本上对基模型训练两个轮次；DPO 随后在偏好对上训练一个轮次，其中同一问题的正确样本被优先于不正确样本。 这些基线方法检验反复观察到的错误模式能否被学习消除，而不是在推理时借助互补的外部证据来绕过。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates how unrestricted cross-agent communication can overturn initially correct independent solutions. In this DetectBench example, DeepSeek-v4-Flash and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct both select the gold answer D in the first round. After observing the other agents’ responses, however, both revise their answers to C. Although Qwen3-4B moves in the opposite direction and corrects its answer from C to D, it is outvoted by the three agents that ultimately select C. The second communication round therefore converts a split panel containing two correct solutions into an incorrect majority decision.
paragraphs.zh: 图4展示了不受限制的智能体间通信如何推翻最初正确的独立解。 在这个 DetectBench 示例中，DeepSeek-v4-Flash 和 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 在第一轮都选择了金标准答案 D。 然而，在观察到其他智能体的回复后，两者都将答案修改为 C。 虽然 Qwen3-4B 朝相反方向移动，将答案从 C 更正为 D，但它被最终选择 C 的三个智能体的多数票所压制。 因此，第二轮通信将一个包含两个正确解的分裂小组转变为一个错误的多数决定。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows Dia on the same question.
